title: Richard Carapaz Breaks Contract with EF Education-EasyPost to Join NSN in Transfer Stunner
content:
Carapaz and NSN Cycling Team confirm three-year deal that leaves a void at EF and will reshape grand tour racing in 2027.

Read the full article at Richard Carapaz Breaks Contract with EF Education-EasyPost to Join NSN in Transfer Stunner on Velo.
author: Jim Cotton
